rationale: V12 reversal paths degraded within-path in 2025H2 and are closed. V20 tests a distinct continuation mechanism based on a completed intraday impulse, not reversal/reclaim/rescue of V12.

must_not_duplicate: Consensus min95 / ATR OOD / V44 cooldown work
prospective shadow and daily-anchor integrity work

data_contract.daily_usage: previous completed daily close/volume eligibility only; no same-day finalized daily anchors before availability
data_contract.universe: JPX individual-stock research universe with existing production-like prior-day close <= 1000 JPY and prior-day volume >= 10000 shares

event_mechanism.name: session impulse continuation
event_mechanism.definition: A completed session bar showing positive directional impulse and broad-range close strength relative to its own recent completed-session history. This is continuation after demonstrated demand, not an oversold/reversal trigger.
signal_conditions: true_range_pct = (high - low) / close is at or above its trailing-20 completed-session median
session_return is at or above its trailing-20 completed-session 75th percentile
event_mechanism.score: mean percentile rank within the signal cohort of session_return, close_location, true_range_pct, and volume_ratio; all descending
event_mechanism.ties: stable symbol ascending after score descending
event_mechanism.cooldown: 5 official XTKS sessions per symbol; independent cooldown state for each TopN policy

periods.discovery_status: retrospective; period has been exposed by other families, so this is not pristine OOS
periods.year_2026: CLOSED_FOR_SELECTION_AND_TUNING; report-only only under a separately frozen later contract

endpoint: next official XTKS session open to fifth official XTKS session close
required_reporting: Top1/Top3/Top5 winner-excluded means where sample permits
